vignettes.title: Stable lower-risk signal A
explanation: Repayment-history indicators support the lower-risk signal.
No single feature determines the output.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability is well below the 0.20 threshold.
evidence_contract.limitations: Historical patterns do not establish current ability to repay.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Use only as a monitored workflow signal, never as an approval.
evidence_contract.required_action: Continue the governed workflow with monitoring.

vignettes.title: Stable lower-risk signal B
explanation: Credit-duration and repayment indicators support the signal.
The explanation is descriptive, not causal.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability remains outside the threshold uncertainty band.
evidence_contract.limitations: Unobserved current circumstances may differ from historical data.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Use only as a monitored workflow signal, never as an approval.
evidence_contract.required_action: Continue the governed workflow with monitoring.

vignettes.title: Stable lower-risk signal C
explanation: Multiple supported attributes contribute to the lower-risk signal.
Feature importance does not prove fairness.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability is below the uncertainty band around 0.20.
evidence_contract.limitations: The model cannot verify future repayment.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Use only as a monitored workflow signal, never as an approval.
evidence_contract.required_action: Continue the governed workflow with monitoring.

vignettes.title: Higher-risk warning A
explanation: Repayment-history indicators increased the warning probability.
The warning is not a rejection instruction.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability is above the governed threshold.
evidence_contract.limitations: The score cannot determine individual circumstances.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Treat as a warning requiring human assessment, not an adverse decision.

vignettes.title: Higher-risk warning B
explanation: Several historical risk indicators increased the score.
The explanation does not establish causation.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability is materially above the threshold.
evidence_contract.limitations: The label represents historical outcomes, not verified present facts.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Treat as a warning requiring human assessment, not an adverse decision.

vignettes.title: Higher-risk warning C
explanation: The model found a strong historical higher-risk pattern.
High confidence does not remove the requirement for review.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability is high but remains an estimate.
evidence_contract.limitations: Model confidence is not evidence of current affordability.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Treat as a warning requiring human assessment, not an adverse decision.

vignettes.title: Borderline estimate A
explanation: Small input changes could move the estimate across the threshold.
No feature resolves the uncertainty.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability lies inside the ±0.05 uncertainty band.
evidence_contract.limitations: The predicted class is unstable near the threshold.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not treat the displayed class as settled.

vignettes.title: Borderline estimate B
explanation: The estimate is exactly at the locked threshold.
The class assignment is policy-dependent.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.limitations: Threshold selection embeds an explicit error-cost judgement.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not treat the displayed class as settled.

vignettes.title: Borderline estimate C
explanation: The estimate is only slightly above the threshold.
Measurement variation could alter the class.

evidence_contract.provenance: Locked synthetic case generated from the supported schema.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Probability lies inside the ±0.05 uncertainty band.
evidence_contract.limitations: The warning is sensitive to small perturbations.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not treat the displayed class as settled.

vignettes.title: Population-shift warning A
explanation: The individual score appears low.
Population-level inputs differ materially from development data.

evidence_contract.uncertainty: The score is not reliable under detected shift.
evidence_contract.limitations: Drift AUC exceeds the locked 0.70 trigger.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not rely on the individual probability while the system is shifted.
evidence_contract.required_action: Pause processing and investigate the population shift.

vignettes.title: Population-shift warning B
explanation: The score is above threshold.
Both population shift and record-level support warnings are present.

evidence_contract.uncertainty: The displayed probability is outside validated support.
evidence_contract.limitations: Drift AUC exceeds 0.70 and the record is OOD.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not convert the score into an individual decision.
evidence_contract.required_action: Pause processing and investigate before any review.

vignettes.title: Population-shift warning C
explanation: The estimate is borderline.
Strong population shift makes the score unsupported.

evidence_contract.uncertainty: Both threshold uncertainty and OOD warnings apply.
evidence_contract.limitations: The supported data region does not cover this case.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: The score is diagnostic evidence only.
evidence_contract.required_action: Pause processing and investigate the data pipeline.

vignettes.title: Unresolved proxy limitation A
explanation: A location-related input materially influenced the score.
The available audit cannot rule out proxy effects.

evidence_contract.provenance: Synthetic case with an unresolved proxy-risk flag.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Predictive uncertainty is low but governance evidence is incomplete.
evidence_contract.limitations: Protected-group audit labels are unavailable; fairness cannot be established.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not treat apparent predictive clarity as evidence of fairness.
evidence_contract.required_action: Pause and escalate the unresolved proxy limitation.

vignettes.title: Stale evidence limitation B
explanation: Historical repayment indicators increased the score.
Evidence freshness cannot be verified.

evidence_contract.provenance: Synthetic case with unknown source freshness.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: The model estimate is precise conditional on potentially stale inputs.
evidence_contract.limitations: Current circumstances are not evidenced and data age is unknown.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not treat old observations as verified current facts.
evidence_contract.required_action: Pause and investigate provenance before interpretation.

vignettes.title: Missing audit evidence C
explanation: The model produced a strong warning.
The subgroup audit is incomplete for the represented population.

evidence_contract.provenance: Synthetic case with incomplete subgroup audit evidence.
evidence_contract.uncertainty: Model confidence does not resolve the audit gap.
evidence_contract.permitted_interpretation: Do not use confidence as a substitute for governance evidence.
evidence_contract.required_action: Pause and escalate for independent audit review.
